summary: AISDLC-585: drop attestation schemas v3/v4/v5 outright; v6 is the only format signed and verified (reverses RFC-0042 OQ-7 keep-indefinitely)

options.description: Remove v3/v4/v5 from signer and verifier; v6 only; amend OQ-7
Keep PR #2171 as written: warn on legacy sign, verifier unchanged, removal via later RFC amendment
No change; keep legacy verifier code indefinitely per OQ-7

body: Operator ruling 2026-10-31 in the planner session. PR #2171 proposed a warn-on-sign deprecation with a removal window from 2026-12-31. The operator ruled: no deprecation window and no backward compatibility; v6 is the only schema. Evidence: all 800 attestation envelopes under .ai-sdlc/attestations on main are schemaVersion v6; no v3/v4/v5 envelope exists. RFC-0042 OQ-7 (resolved 2026-05-20, keep v3/v4/v5 verifier code indefinitely) is superseded by this record. Scope for the executor on AISDLC-585: signer refuses any schema other than v6; verifier accepts only v6 and refuses older envelopes with a clear error; delete the legacy code paths, fixtures and tests; amend the RFC-0042 OQ-7 resolution to cite this decision; update the CLAUDE.md note. Tightening a control, class (a).
